scratchpad_checklist: Investigate the question with BrowserModule browser_search/browser_navigate (locating terms with browser_find, scrolling deeper sections with browser_scroll, and clicking relevant links/tabs/controls with browser_click) or KnowledgeModule search_local_docs
Store verified findings into knowledge memory using KnowledgeModule store_fact

Write a structured findings report (research_report.md or findings_report.md) with markdown headers and at least 3 distinct numbered real http(s):// URL citations, e.g. [1] https://..., [2] https://..., [3] https://...; minimum 2 required) using WorkspaceModule create_file

post_llm_validation_hook.on_failure_instruction: Research deliverable verification failed. Ensure you have recorded verified facts with KnowledgeModule.store_fact and written a comprehensive markdown report (at least 350 characters, with markdown headers and at least 2 distinct real http(s):// source URLs from your visited/retrieved pages) to research_report.md or findings_report.md before completing.
